minecraft_campfire_cosy_smoke.description: a single puffy light grey-beige cloud hovering in the sky above the horizon anchor, slowly morphing shape and drifting; visible at t3, t8 and t20 in front and threequarter views; not discernible in any top view (only the background dirt debris there)
minecraft_campfire_cosy_smoke.notes: absent from top view - likely outside the top camera framing or too faint from above

minecraft_dragon_breath.description: compact cloud of vivid magenta-fuchsia specks with a partial internal gap, floating mid-air; present at all ticks in front and threequarter views, slightly shrunken by t20; nothing visible in top view

minecraft_dust_plume.description: two small loose clusters of grey-brown specks near the top edge of the front t3 cell only; a couple of matching specks in threequarter t3; nothing at t8 or t20 and nothing in top view
minecraft_dust_plume.notes: particles sit at the very top edge of the frame at t3 - the plume may have already risen out of its dense phase, or the emission is partly clipped by the frame

minecraft_explosion_emitter.description: a massive billowing grey-white smoke cloud fills most of the frame at t3 from all angles including top view, where it spreads over the ground; almost entirely dissipated by t8 (only faint residual wisps in threequarter and top t8) and fully gone by t20

minecraft_firework.description: clusters of white x-shaped sparkle bursts floating in the sky at t3 and t8 in front and threequarter views; in the top view at t8 the same effect appears as a wide scatter of white square sparkles spread over the grass; everything gone by t20
minecraft_firework.notes: top view at t8 shows the sparkles scattered on the ground plane - particles fall rather than stay airborne

minecraft_heart.description: a single pixel-art red heart sprite floating in the sky at t3 in the front view, with only a tiny red speck clipped at the top edge of the threequarter t3 cell; nothing at t8 or t20 and nothing in top view
minecraft_heart.notes: only one heart particle captured - the effect appears to be a single-emission icon

minecraft_large_smoke.description: a dense cluster of black and dark-grey square smoke particles at t3 in front and threequarter views, high in the frame; one stray speck lingers at front t8; nothing at t20 and nothing in top view
minecraft_large_smoke.notes: despite the shot name the visible cluster is small-medium and very brief

minecraft_reverse_portal.description: a small swirling vortex of purple-magenta particles forming an elongated spiral shape, present at t3 and t8 in front and threequarter views; gone by t20; nothing in top view

minecraft_snowflake.description: several white hexagonal snowflake-shaped sprites drifting downward at t3 in front and threequarter views, thinning to a few small white specks at t8 and only a couple of specks by t20 (front view); top view shows only the background dirt debris and a few white specks near the frame edge at t20

minecraft_trial_omen.description: two small cyan-teal skull-shaped sprites floating in the sky at t3 in the front view, plus one clipped teal speck at the top edge of the threequarter t3 cell; nothing at t8 or t20 and nothing in top view
minecraft_trial_omen.notes: zoomed crop confirms a distinct skull-face silhouette on both sprites; particles sit high in the frame

minecraft_white_smoke.description: a loose cluster of pale pinkish-white specks at t3 in front and threequarter views; nothing at t8 or t20 and nothing in top view
minecraft_white_smoke.notes: low contrast against the sky - the emission may be under-dense or nearly finished by t3

world_event_PARTICLES_AND_SOUND_PLANT_GR.description: every cell matches the empty baseline - flat grass and sky horizon in front and threequarter views, grass plus the persistent brown dirt debris in top views; no particles at any angle or tick
world_event_PARTICLES_AND_SOUND_PLANT_GR.notes: pixel-level diff against the empty baseline sheet is zero in every front and threequarter cell - the expected green growth sparkles were not captured; they may have spawned below the frame or failed to emit

world_event_PARTICLES_MOBBLOCK_SPAWN.description: a wide burst of small orange-yellow flame sprites mixed with dark smoke specks scattered across the upper frame at t3 in front and threequarter views; a few residual flames near the top edge at front t8; gone by t20; nothing in top view

world_event_PARTICLES_TRIAL_SPAWNER_DETE.description: a sparse vertical trail of tiny teal-cyan specks descending from the top edge of the front t3 cell only; every other cell at every angle and tick is empty baseline
world_event_PARTICLES_TRIAL_SPAWNER_DETE.notes: specks enter from above the frame - the main body of the effect is likely above the captured area

superheroes_cap_shield_slam_burst.description: a small cluster of soft round cream-white puffs present at all ticks in front and threequarter views, drifting laterally and gradually fading by t20; nothing in top view

superheroes_homelander_clap_flash.description: every cell equals the empty baseline - no particles at any angle or any tick; top views show only the background dirt debris
superheroes_homelander_clap_flash.notes: a flash effect may decay before the first capture tick t3, or the emission failed; this sheet was also used as the pixel baseline and shows zero diffs in all cells

superheroes_jiwald_effect.description: a bright white angular shape built of overlapping squares, resembling a stepped glyph or folded sigil, hovering above the horizon at all ticks in front and threequarter views; slightly smaller and noticeably translucent by t20; nothing in top view
superheroes_jiwald_effect.notes: the shape reads as a stylized glyph rather than an organic particle - possibly a single large quad or a tight formation

superheroes_purple_flame.description: a cluster of purple-magenta flame tongues with bright whitish cores rising above the anchor at all ticks in front and threequarter views; in the top view at t20 the same effect appears as huge soft translucent purple billboards covering part of the frame
superheroes_purple_flame.notes: top-view quads confirm the effect renders as camera-facing billboards - from above they fill large screen areas

superheroes_sun_particle.description: a small cluster of golden four-point star sparkles floating above the horizon at t3 and t8 in front and threequarter views, reduced to a faint sparkle remnant at t20; nothing in top view
